This is definitely not the correct way to handle this situation.

When I moved into the apartment, I specifically confirmed whether I would be able to extend my stay for 5 more days, and I clearly mentioned that I wanted to do so. I chose this apartment mainly because of that option.

Because of this, I expect your support in resolving the issue. At the moment, there has clearly been a mistake, as I was given incorrect information.

Please kindly correct this situation and help me proceed with the 5-day extension.
